metadata.description: Local marketplace vendoring the design, motion, component, and build skills used to ship client websites from this repo.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence: 84 UI styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 98 UX guidelines, and 25 chart types across 22 tech stacks.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend development: 23 commands (polish, audit, critique, etc.) plus curated anti-pattern detection.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's official skill for creating distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces that avoid generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Anti-slop frontend taste: design-taste-frontend, brutalist, minimalist, high-end agency visuals, redesign audits, image-to-code, brandkit, and design-reference image generation.

plugins.name: anthropic-design
plugins.description: Anthropic design and web skills: canvas design, brand guidelines, theme factory, web artifact building, webapp browser testing, and algorithmic art.

plugins.name: anthropic-documents
plugins.description: Document generation for client-facing work: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and PDF (proposals, invoices, contracts, one-pagers).

plugins.name: anthropic-builder
plugins.description: Tooling for building your own automation: skill authoring, MCP server building, Claude API reference, and document co-authoring.

plugins.name: anthropic-extras
plugins.description: Remaining Anthropic example skills: internal comms, Claude Academy guide, discernment nudge, and Slack GIF creator. Off by default - not website work.

plugins.name: vercel-web
plugins.description: Vercel's web craft skills: web design guidelines, React best practices, composition patterns, view transitions, and writing guidelines for UI copy.

plugins.name: vercel-deploy
plugins.description: Shipping and performance: deploy to Vercel, Vercel CLI with tokens, and Core Web Vitals / bundle optimization.

plugins.name: vercel-react-native
plugins.description: React Native / Expo mobile skills. Off by default - not website work.

plugins.name: web-motion-core
plugins.description: Core motion stack: Three.js/WebGL, GSAP ScrollTrigger, React Three Fiber, Framer Motion, Babylon.js.

plugins.name: web-motion-components
plugins.description: Animated component libraries (Magic UI, React Bits), Anime.js, Lottie, React Spring, and scroll-reveal libraries.

plugins.name: web-motion-scroll
plugins.description: Scroll and lightweight 3D: Locomotive Scroll, Barba.js page transitions, PixiJS, PlayCanvas, A-Frame WebXR, lightweight 3D effects.

plugins.name: web-motion-meta
plugins.description: Modern web design principles and web3D integration patterns - picks the right motion/3D approach for the job.

plugins.name: web-motion-authoring
plugins.description: Heavy 3D authoring pipelines: Blender to web, Rive, Spline, Substance 3D texturing. Off by default - turn on for 3D-heavy builds.

plugins.name: 21st
plugins.description: 21st.dev (formerly Magic MCP): search and install real UI components, logos as SVG, and AI UI generation. Needs API_KEY_21ST.

plugins.name: convex-backend
plugins.description: 33 Convex backend skills: schema design, auth, crons, migrations, deploy guards, cost/monitoring. Off by default - only for app builds with a Convex backend.
